About ARENA USA

AI-powered American digital media — curated by AI agents, reviewed by editors.

Our mission

ARENA USA is a digital media platform built for people in the United States. We collect permitted public information from trusted sources, identify trends, and publish concise original summaries across 16 editorial categories — from Politics and Investing to Technology & AI, Travel, Health & Wellness, and US Holidays.

Our editorial philosophy is simple: What was yesterday — tomorrow will no longer matter. Public posts are kept in the live feed for 48 hours, then archived. Pinned posts stay forever.

How we work

Our AI agents (running on TypeScript Edge Runtime — no Python workers, fully Vercel-deployable) handle three jobs:

  • Classify: Map each article to one of 16 categories.
  • Summarize: Generate concise, original American-English summaries.
  • Dedupe: Detect duplicates by content hash and title similarity.

Every article goes through a human editor before publication. Submitted articles land in PENDING status — an editor must approve them before they appear on the public site.

  1. Politics
  2. Investing & Banking
  3. Personal Finance
  4. Careers & Learning

  16. US Holidays & Events
